title: Use of 'the' before BMW vehicle names in body copy
quote: the refined elegance of a new BMW 3 Series sedan ... the commanding presence of a new BMW X5 SUV ... The BMW X3 is a frequent favorite ... the BMW 5 Series for their daily commutes
recommendation: BMW brand guidelines specify vehicle names should not be preceded by 'The' (e.g., 'BMW iX3' not 'The BMW iX3'), with the only exception being 'The new BMW [model]' format for launches within 6 months. Update homepage FAQ body copy to remove 'the' preceding BMW model names where the launch exception does not apply.

title: Use of 'car/cars' instead of 'vehicle/vehicles' in BMW communications
quote: Wide Variety of New and Used Cars for Sale ... Used Cars for Sale in Alhambra, CA ... any car dealer in Alhambra ... various pre-owned cars from other luxury manufacturers
recommendation: BMW guideline BMW-COPY-002 instructs the use of 'vehicle' rather than 'car' in all BMW communications. Replace 'cars' with 'vehicles' in homepage copy, page titles ('Used Cars for Sale' → 'Used Vehicles for Sale'), and CTAs across dealer-authored content.

title: Use of restricted word 'Deals' in BMW page title

Replace 'BMW Lease Deals' in the incentives page title and any equivalent on-page H1 with brand-aligned phrasing such as 'BMW Lease Offers' or 'Current BMW Offers'.
